event: The party rests in the plain, functional Transition Hall between Floor 11 and Floor 12.
Vesper claims the south corner and sets the Field Forge cycling.
Nadia chalks a face on calcium deposits by the west wall and throws knives at it.
Dayo sits against the east wall with the First Boss Coat off, cleaning its left shoulder guard.
Nadia catches Dayo's eye, looks away, and keeps throwing.
Solenne notes the guard's new eighth dent, from a Spore Anchor tendril slamming Dayo into a wall.
Solenne avoids thinking about the Spore Anchor bonus objectives they narrowly missed.
She rereads her Floor 11 notebook lines, including the six-tendril fight note.
She holds back a fifth line about Miriam's MP costs until she knows what to do with it.
Tomás is away, confirming the first two chambers of Floor 12.
Miriam writes in her clinical notebook near the System terminal without sharing it.
Footsteps approach from the lower corridor, the quadrant Tomás would cover.
A mid-forties woman with a System Scholar pin and a notebook enters by the lower door.
Arcane Analysis shows Dr. Petra Vasic, System Scholar, with no Harmony Aspect or Resonance.
The Harmony Conductor stays silent around her.
Vasic stops three meters from Solenne and sweeps the party with her eyes.
Vasic introduces herself and asks if this is a reasonable time to talk.
Nadia hits the chalk face between the eyes and says they are very approachable.
Dayo puts on the First Boss Coat and stands just left of Solenne's elbow, watching Vasic.
Vasic says she studies composite resonance perception and has questions for the party.
Solenne feels the pull of finally having a name for what she perceives.
Solenne agrees to answer.
Vasic asks about Harmony activation rates per floor.
Solenne notices Vasic writes around the numbers, as if confirming estimates.
Vasic offers a RES range of fourteen to twenty-one, close but not quite right.
Miriam puts down her pen and goes still, observing.
Solenne asks where her records come from; Vasic cites other parties and public logs.
Vasic says they are the highest-RES party at Floor 11 and won't say how many she tracks.
Nadia stops throwing and leans on the west wall, arms folded, watching Vasic.
Solenne answers three questions about composite perception before catching herself.
Solenne scales back her fourth answer, holding back the Surge and Six of Six perception.
Vasic asks if the perception ever gave new information; Solenne says yes, once.
Vasic stops writing for the first time and looks up at Solenne.
Miriam closes her clinical notebook, done taking inventory.
Vasic asks about call-and-response coordination; Solenne says it develops like any skill.
Vasic hands Solenne a once-folded paper she says gives context for something ahead.
The paper is a System Reference Document: Floor 17, quadrant NW, alcove 7-B.
Below the coordinates are columns of an unknown script Solenne cannot identify.
Vasic says it marks a locked room no current key opens but the party may.
Solenne sees the script differs from the sealed-space text Tomás copied.
Asked where she got it, Vasic says only 'Research' and tells Solenne not to lose it.
Vasic thanks them and leaves through the lower door as Dayo watches.
Tomás steps in through the upper door after forty minutes away.
Tomás says they had company; Solenne explains and shows him the paper.
Tomás studies the notation longer than the coordinates.
Tomás says Vasic asked about composite perception before asking if Solenne had it.
He concludes her questions were confirmation, not inquiry, and returns the paper.
Vesper notes the bearing is very precise for someone claiming not to know what's there.
Nadia joins the group and jokes they are being studied for a paper without peer review.
Miriam says Vasic wrote around the answers and leaned in on the unanswered one.
Solenne admits she scaled back; Miriam says Vasic noticed too.
Miriam adds that Vasic never asked where they were going.
Solenne turns the paper over; the back is blank.
Nadia predicts Vasic will come back, since she never closed the loop.
Nadia's Status Window chimes with a level-up.
Nadia reaches level 10, gaining Jester Flourish.
Miriam reaches level 10 with Mending Touch at its Tier I maximum.
Nadia reads her Class Aptitude Assessment twice and seals off her reaction.
Miriam notes she hit the Tier I ceiling and writes it down.
Vesper congratulates both and keeps watching Nadia; Nadia answers with a flag-like smile.
Dayo, still cleaning the dent, says they should move.
Solenne folds the paper into her utility belt pocket beside the compass.
Solenne reasons Vasic is studying them as the clearest or only example of something.
Nadia says both seem bad; Solenne says both seem useful to Vasic.
Solenne tells them Vasic once called the perception 'Full Chord.'
Dayo puts away the cloth, checks the shoulder guard, and says 'Let's go.'
Nadia pulls Dave Jr. from the chalk face and compares Vasic's study to theirs of the Tower.
Nadia wraps on her green scarf and says the universe has very consistent taste.
Tomás opens the upper door and Solenne goes through toward the Calcite Labyrinth.
Solenne finds her pen already in her hand.
